title: Visitors read Theme Kits and Nocturne: the /themes pages, the Nocturne sales page and their SEO titles use the new names
detail: Copy only. "Mega Theme" reads as Theme Kits and the Midnight theme as Nocturne on /themes, /themes/[theme] and the Midnight feature page (themeDisplayName in lib/themes/library.ts, SEO titles in lib/seo/frequency-pages.ts). Ids, the Midnight editor value, saved site styles and the /themes/midnight address are unchanged. Still on the old name until Daniel releases the pins: the in-product theme picker label (site-style.test.ts pins it) and the /themes/midnight address (midnight-feature-page and midnight-demo probes pin it).

verify.evidence: lib/themes/library.ts exports themeDisplayName and maps midnight to Nocturne.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");const t=f.readFileSync("lib/themes/library.ts","utf8");if(!t.includes("themeDisplayName")||!t.includes("Nocturne")){console.error("the Nocturne display name is gone");process.exit(1)}'
